name: composition_mounts_the_ca_router
reason: The composition root mounts routes::ca::router on the gateway listener. This slice does not edit route mount lines or the rivethub composition.

name: crl_reload_without_listener_restart
reason: The gateway listener reads the CRL when it builds its rustls verifier. Watching that file and rebuilding the acceptor is outside this route slice.

name: mesh_channel_optional_client_certificates
reason: The mesh agent channel still requires a client certificate. Only the gateway listener allows a missing certificate so token enrollment can sign.
